newsitem.title: UK: Lorry crashes onto line, blocks railway.
newsitem.headline: Lorry crashes onto line, blocks railway.

text.p: A lorry driver died on Friday when his truck crashed off a bridge onto a railway line, blocking the main West Coast rail services.
The early morning crash took place near the village of Millmeece in Staffordshire.
Rescue workers could not approach the truck until the railway power had been switched off. Frozen food from the lorry's load was scattered across the track whose northbound services had to be halted.
